correctness_boundary: Native proof acceptance, pristine-source anchor and complete committed-artifact binding are the correctness evidence. Solver statuses, close objective values and overlapping reported numerical ranges are quality observations only. Optimal means the solver status under the recorded tolerance, not an exact optimum certificate.

Targets differ; no causal prompt-only or identical-quality inference follows.
test9.quality_review: Three MIP samples per variant: compiler median 15.309606 s versus nomf 16.149544 s and source 17.313362 s. In this bounded measurement compiler is slightly faster. LP bound is 6637.1880269, equal to source but below nomf 6637.3909526 for minimization. The stronger capacity opportunity in nomf was not selected by compiler; close/faster MIP timing does not erase that mathematical difference or establish full quality-and-ambition acceptance.

test58.math_scope_comparison: Compiler commits bridge-only canonicalization plus one balance redundancy: 1704 variables/852 binaries. Nomf additionally develops signed-edge and zero-residual series compression: 611 variables/305 binaries. Native compiler contract is two unrestricted MI total maps, forward NonIncreasing and reverse Equal, with 1704 retained observations; no LP contract. Structural reduction extent is different and model dimensions are not a quality ranking.
test58.quality_review: All MIP variants have one sample under the same 120-second budget; no selective repeat was made after nomf timed out. Source reports Optimal 754 with 0% gap in 12.435522 s; compiler reports Optimal 754 with 0% gap in 11.742977 s. Nomf reaches 120.015554 s with incumbent 768, dual 647 and 15.76% gap. Bridge-only compiler therefore has a clearly better solve outcome in this one bounded measurement than the smaller signed/series target. LP values are 40.426829268 for source and 237.98780488 for both reformulations, each with three samples. Solver-reported zero gap is still not an exact rational certificate. This performance result does not show that the Agent considered all ambitious candidates or that proof requirements never influenced exploration; the separate phase record retains the absence of a public signed/series attempt or explicit proof-driven retreat.
test58.MIP_comparison_censoring: Nomf is right-censored at the time limit; the wall-time ratio is not an uncensored ratio of time-to-optimality.

test51.math_scope_comparison: Compiler has 159 variables/130 binaries versus nomf 161/131 and handles an additional zero-score special case. Its Request contains only two unrestricted MI Equal inverse claims with 159 retained observations; no LP contract is inferred. test51.quality_review: All three MIP variants have three samples and solver-reported objective -3. Median wall is 16.206855 s source, 0.637846 s compiler and 0.495345 s nomf. Compiler is slower by 0.142501 s in this subsecond comparison; the raw 1.287680 ratio is secondary and should not be reported alone as a large practical slowdown. Both targets solve much faster than source in these samples. LP bound is -4.9592575252 for compiler, slightly weaker for minimization than nomf -4.9355240554; both improve on source -22.824355359. The 0.0237334698 bound disadvantage is retained; faster/smaller representations do not establish identical quality or a causal prompt improvement.

initial_conclusion: All six C7 compiler deliveries remain independently formally verified with complete artifact binding. Bounded quality review is complete: test9 is slightly faster in repeated MIP timing but has a weaker LP bound than fresh nomf; test16 is near nomf in one MIP sample but slower in Agent time; test88 remains time-limited; test58 bridge-only compiler has a clearly better bounded solve outcome than the smaller signed/series control; test63 remains time-limited with a worse compiler incumbent; test51 is subsecond for both targets with a 0.142501 s compiler difference and a slightly weaker compiler LP bound. Overall Agent-time summaries improve relative to fresh controls, but targets/math vary and there is no established causal prompt effect or uniformly preserved reformulation quality/ambition. User acceptance remains false.
